meta.name: ai-act-readiness
meta.description: /cs:ai-act-readiness <system> — EU AI Act 6-question forcing interrogation. Use during AI-system intake, before EU deployment, or during annual compliance refresh as Article 113 obligations phase in (2025-02-02 / 2025-08-02 / 2026-08-02 / 2027-08-02).

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 评估AI系统是否符合欧盟AI法案要求
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要确保AI系统符合欧盟AI法案的合规要求。
copy.tagline_en: Assess AI system compliance with EU AI Act requirements
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to ensure your AI system meets EU AI Act obligations.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会引导你回答欧盟 AI 法案的 6 个强制问题，帮你判断系统是否合规、属于哪类风险、需要什么评估，并输出一份合规报告。
howto.when: 当你输入“/cs:ai-act-readiness <系统名称>”时触发。适合在将 AI 系统投放欧盟市场前、年度合规审查时，或系统发生重大变更后使用。

say.text: 帮我评估一下这个新聊天机器人是否符合欧盟 AI 法案。
say.note: Claude 会启动 6 个问题的合规检查流程。

say.text: 运行 /cs:ai-act-readiness 人脸识别系统。
say.note: 直接触发该技能，开始评估指定系统。

say.text: 检查我们公司的 AI 招聘工具是否属于高风险。
say.note: Claude 会重点回答第 2 个问题（高风险分类）。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will guide you through 6 mandatory EU AI Act questions to assess if your AI system is compliant, classify its risk tier, determine required conformity assessment, and output a readiness report.
howto.when_en: Triggered by typing "/cs:ai-act-readiness <system>". Use before placing an AI system on the EU market, during annual compliance refresh, or after a material change.

say_en.text: Assess this new chatbot for EU AI Act compliance.

say_en.note: Directly triggers the skill for the specified system.

say_en.text: Check if our AI hiring tool is high-risk.
